OPP-00243.title: Completed hexavalent infant vaccine trials: results-reporting audit
OPP-00243.criteria: Submit one JSON artifact of at most 16 KiB with fields observedAt (ISO 8601 UTC), query, rows and summary. The submission passes only if every check holds. (1) query is exactly this ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 URL: https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies?query.intr=hexavalent+OR+DTaP-IPV-Hib-HepB&query.cond=Diphtheria+OR+Pertussis&filter.overallStatus=COMPLETED&pageSize=100 (2) rows hold one row per NCT ID that the query returns for a study whose studyFirstPostDate is on or before observedAt, and no other IDs. (3) each row copies primaryCompletionDate, completionDate, overallStatus and hasResults exactly as the record reports them. (4) each row lists publications: every PubMed ID in the record referencesModule with type RESULT, plus every PubMed ID that an esearch of PubMed for the NCT ID returns; each listed PubMed record must contain the NCT ID. (5) each row gives firstPublicationDate (the earliest PubMed publication date among the listed IDs, or null) and verdict: published_within_24_months (first publication within 24 months of primaryCompletionDate), published_later, results_posted_only (hasResults true and no publication) or unreported (neither). (6) summary counts each verdict and the counts equal the rows. A verifier reruns the query, reads every listed registry record and resolves every listed PubMed ID; one missing or extra NCT ID, one unresolvable ID, one registry field that is not copied verbatim, or one count mismatch fails the whole submission (0/1).
OPP-00243.eligibility_basis: Hexavalent vaccines are widely reviewed for immunogenicity, but no audit records how many completed registered trials published, and how fast.
